culprit_citations.quoted_text: Ratio of net investment income to average Members' Capital | 10.06 %

rationale: F16 fires because source distributions of 16.38 per unit exceed 1.5 times the 10.06% net investment income ratio threshold. The raw source also discloses that 6.04 per unit, or $83.736 million in the statement of changes, was return of capital. That makes the high distribution rate a disclosed fund outcome rather than a fund_financials data defect.
